name: ansible-lsp-client
description: Go-to-definition for Ansible file references, backed by a Rust language server.

ansibleLsp.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show the grey inline hints describing what a `when:` does on a run with no extra vars. Turn this off to remove the hints entirely. Diagnostics are unaffected.

ansibleLsp.inlayHints.tooltips.description: Show the hover tooltip on `import_playbook` hints, reporting how many tasks and plays the condition is copied onto. Does not affect the hints themselves — that is Inlay Hints: Enabled.

ansibleLsp.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the ansible-lsp binary. Defaults to ../target/release/ansible-lsp relative to this extension.

ansibleLsp.trace.server.description: Log LSP traffic to the 'Ansible LSP' output channel.
